from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single extracted data point for Cash Flows from Financing Activities from one document."""
    fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year the data point applies to")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the document (e.g. 'Net cash used in financing activities')")
    amount: float = Field(description="The magnitude of the cash flow amount")
    direction: str = Field(description="Whether the cash flow was 'provided' by or 'used' in financing")
    unit_scale: str = Field(description="The scale of the amount, e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    statement_section: str = Field(description="The section of the report where this was found, e.g. 'Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate extraction from a single document."""
    financing_cash_flows: list[CashFlowRecord]
